svg.title: 3-layer Terraform module stack with Terragrunt
svg.desc: Terragrunt units in live/eu-central-1/prod (network, eks, ecs, ecr) run small composition roots, which call infrastructure modules, which call resource modules. Orange arrows show outputs passed between units by dependency blocks and wiring inside modules. The bootstrap stack creates the state bucket whose name is set once in live/root.hcl.
svg.text: Terragrunt units in live/ run small composition roots, which call infrastructure modules, which call resource modules. Outputs move between units through dependency blocks.
Per-environment values, generated backend and provider, run order. One state per unit.
composition/<component>: small root modules, the same for every environment. Locals for tags and names.
vpc_id, subnets, image URL arrive as inputs
Opinionated building blocks. Apply naming, tags and policies, then call one or more resource modules.
Thin, generic wrappers around raw aws_* / kubernetes_* resources. No knowledge of the environment.
output → input (dependency block between units, or wiring inside a module)
